# Synthetic Visuals 5 visual reference

The Agent Conference dashboard adapts the three-panel layout, dark palette,
and compact tile treatment of Synthetic Visuals 5. The conference's content,
states, and controls are driven by CTMAO-NSD events rather than the reference
simulation.

Synthetic Visuals 5 credits the MIT-licensed
[ATSMATRIX-LEAD-SWARM](https://github.com/anyel1to/ATSMATRIX-LEAD-SWARM)
project. Its copyright notice is reproduced below.
